voice.name: Sulafat
voice.style: Clear, natural English for an adult airport listening lesson. Warm and conversational, with distinct questions and answers. Use a natural learning pace and light emphasis on the information a traveler must confirm. Do not sing, spell ordinary words, or add any words.

youtube.title: A cancelled flight | Airport English Day 58
youtube.description:
Your flight is cancelled; can you confirm a replacement before accepting it?

Practice checking replacement flight times and asking what happens to seats and baggage.

Fictional airport conversations for listening practice. Numbers, airline names and locations are examples, not current travel instructions. Confirm actual arrangements with your airport and airline.

sources.title: Flight delays and cancellations - Air Passenger Protection
